subject: the taproom inside a fantasy medieval inn
scene: Camera at seated eye level in the middle of a warm wooden taproom. A large stone fireplace with a burning fire on one side, long heavy oak tables and benches with pewter tankards and candles, a serving counter with casks and hanging copper mugs on another side, a wooden staircase leading up, small leaded windows, dark beamed ceiling with hanging iron lanterns, animal furs and a shield on the plaster walls, barrels stacked in a corner.
